What the scope can include

A condition survey decides what should be retained, repaired or replaced.

Built around an operating workplaceDepartment-by-department phasing keeps teams moving while the new office takes shape.
01Workspace reconfigurationRebalance desks, meeting rooms, circulation and support areas around the current team.
02Office modernizationRefresh dated interiors with new ceilings, lighting, flooring and finishes.
03Expansion planningConnect added space to the existing office with consistent services and circulation.
04Department upgradesRenovate one team zone at a time while the rest of the workplace stays active.
05Executive areasUpgrade private offices, meeting rooms and client-facing spaces.
06Furniture and joineryCoordinate workstations, storage, counters and custom-built elements.

A process shaped for office renovation

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Workplace audit

Measure the office, map services and identify what can be retained.

02

Occupancy plan

Agree working hours, temporary moves and the order of each zone.

03

Design and BOQ

Resolve layouts, finishes and an itemized trade-by-trade cost plan.

04

Phased execution

Complete noisy work and shutdowns outside agreed operating windows.

05

Handover by zone

Snag, clean and return each completed area to the team.

items.q: Can the office stay open during renovation?
items.a: Often, yes. We phase work by department, floor or operating hours and agree temporary access before site work begins.

items.q: Can you reconfigure an existing office?
items.a: Yes. We can change workstations, meeting rooms, partitions, lighting, power and circulation around the existing shell.

items.q: Do you provide an itemized BOQ?
items.a: Yes. The BOQ separates rooms, trades, quantities and materials before execution.

items.q: How long does office renovation take?
items.a: A focused upgrade may take one to three weeks. Larger occupied offices depend on the number of phases and allowed working hours.

items.a: Choose renovation for an existing workplace. Choose fit-out when a shell or unfinished office needs design and construction for first use.
